questions.q: A disk at 60% utilization growing 4 GB/hour is riskier than a disk at 80% that has been stable for three months. What principle drives this assessment?
options: Static thresholds trigger at 95% regardless of trend
Trajectory matters more than current state — trend, rate of change, and projected time-to-failure define risk
Memory pressure always outweighs disk risk
Replication lag is the leading failure indicator
questions.explain: The chapter replaces static thresholds with trajectory-aware failure probability scores, because a stable system near a threshold is a different risk than an unstable system approaching one from a distance.

questions.q: Why does the predictive pipeline require N consecutive scoring cycles above the threshold before the action executor fires?
options: To batch metrics before calling the LLM
To reduce the Prometheus scrape load
To give the DBA time to manually approve
To prevent a single noisy scoring cycle from triggering an irreversible action like a failover
questions.explain: The confidence window encodes the system's risk tolerance; it stops one anomalous model cycle from firing actions such as an AG failover.

questions.q: Where does the chapter place the computation of rate, trend, and projection metrics such as the disk fill rate?
options: In Prometheus recording rules computed at collection time (predictive_rules.yml)
In Alertmanager route conditions
Inside the LLM diagnosis prompt
At alert evaluation time inside Prometheus alert rules
questions.explain: Deriving trends at collection time separates signal quality from alert latency; computing them at alert-evaluation time couples the two and degrades both.

questions.q: For which model-confidence range does the chapter recommend escalating to LLM reasoning?
options: Every scoring cycle, for all instances
P < 0.25, where signals are too weak to matter
P between 0.50 and 0.75, where the quantitative signals are ambiguous
Only after the action executor has already failed
questions.explain: LLM reasoning is reserved for the ambiguous middle band — novel failure modes the statistical model is unsure about — keeping it off the critical path for confident predictions.

questions.q: Per the chapter's remediation table, what is the prescribed autonomous action when memory pressure (PLE collapse) crosses P > 0.80?
options: Throttle writes and investigate
Kill idle sessions and scale out the app tier
Query kill + cache flush
Pre-position the failover candidate
questions.explain: The remediation table maps PLE collapse at P > 0.80 with a 2-cycle confidence window to killing offending queries and flushing the cache to relieve buffer pressure.
